# Local playback dependencies

HyperFrames player and composition runtime, version0.8.214, from the official `hyperframes` npm package by HeyGen (Apache-2.0). Source: https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes . These are final playback components; Studio/editor is not included.

GSAP3.15.0 from the same package's vendor distribution. CopyrightGreenSock. Standard license and terms: https://gsap.com/standard-license/ . Original distribution header preserved.

DM Sans is loaded from ../../fonts, with SIL OFL distributed there. All dependencies are local so playback does not fetch scripts from a CDN.
